note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>) ; decoy -> no persistence row -> None (oracle stdout: "['CFBundleName', 'CFBundleVersion']")
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes Info.plist: hand-authored heredoc via stdlib plistlib.dumps; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as E,sys;print([e.text for e in E.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot()[0]][::2])" Info.plist  # no Label/Program/StartInterval)
